scope.dataset: 10x GEM-X Human PBMC Donor 1, 96-cell chr1 prepared input

reference_acquisition.interpretation: The download SHA256 is only a receipt fingerprint. The intake receipt reports gzip CRC success, 11 columns, 569005 clusters, and chr1 alias '1' with 51384 rows.

polyasite_source_verification.selection: bulk PolyASite v2.0 Homo sapiens GRCh38.96 only; atlas_sc v3 and MAAPER PolyADB RDS excluded

url_verification.method: HTTP HEAD by the method author; the URL was later downloaded for intake

coordinate_schema.observed_contig_alias: atlas '1' maps one-way to reference 'chr1' for this Q1; no global chr stripping/adding
coordinate_schema.unmatched_policy: retain unmatched chromosome, representative, or strand rows in an NA/fail audit; never coerce to a match

current_dataset_independence.evidence_for_no_overlap: The bulk atlas is based on SRA searches as of June 2019 and its listed human protocols contain no 10x GEM-X category; the target manifest is a later 10x 9.0.0 GEM-X distribution with no accession linking it to atlas samples.
current_dataset_independence.required_inference_limit: This supports operational non-overlap, not certified donor/patient identity independence. Release date is not identity proof.

methods_paper.title: PolyASite 2.0: a consolidated atlas of polyadenylation sites from 3' end sequencing
evidence: Reads were discarded for >6 consecutive A or >7 A in 10 genomically encoded nucleotides downstream of the mapped 3' end.
Libraries retained high-abundance site groups until 90% had a PAS in -60 to +10; 80-90% PAS occurrence near 21 nt upstream is the cited rationale.
Sites within -12/+12 of a stronger site were clustered; PAS-annotated and other clusters could merge within 25 nt.
The atlas page lists AATAAA and ATTAAA as the first two PAS motifs but uses a broader motif panel; it reports 76% of clusters with signal.

license.article_license: CC BY-NC 4.0 for the paper text; this does not by itself establish the database redistribution license.

external_reference_conclusion.decision: Approved as an external comparison/reference, not ground truth and not an independent third metric.
external_reference_conclusion.sample_independence_limit: Operational sample non-overlap is a supported inference; donor/patient identity is not certified, and release date alone is not identity proof.
external_reference_conclusion.metric_independence_limit: Motif, downstream-A, and atlas agreement are correlated because atlas construction used PAS and internal-priming rules.
external_reference_conclusion.construction_clarification: Documented bulk atlas cohorts support operational non-overlap with this GEM-X distribution; no donor-level identity certification is claimed.

boundary_proxy_b0.definition: plus: BED end; minus: BED start
boundary_proxy_b0.meaning: 0f observable cleavage-boundary proxy; the exact cleavage base is not established

base_proxy_p0.definition: plus: BED end - 1; minus: BED start
base_proxy_p0.meaning: last-templated-base proxy used only for comparison with atlas rep0

coordinate_contract.distance_rule: same mapped chromosome and same strand; absolute(p0 - atlas_rep0)
coordinate_contract.forbidden: Do not apply the benchmark context annotator's minus start+1 rule as native 0f fact, and do not subtract one from b0 on both strands.

pipeline_comparison.baseline: existing 96-cell chr1 coverage 3 / minTail 5 revision 0f output
pipeline_comparison.parameter_semantics: This is inclusive per-base unscaled poly(A) bedGraph pileup depth derived after read processing/UMI assignment; it is not tail length and not a per-cell or per-site aggregated support threshold.

common_required_explicits.coverage_scaling: retain baseline; poly(A) depth must remain unscaled/fixed, not dynamic
common_required_explicits.other_parameters: scientific parameters, inputs, and code revision identical to baseline, including non-A allowance, MAPQ, merge distance, expression threshold, reference, BAM, and code revision; generated output paths/run IDs necessarily differ

pipeline_comparison.non_optimization: No grid search, UMAP adjustment, threshold search, metric-guided rerun, or post hoc parameter selection.

sequence_presets.alphabet_and_missingness: Uppercase soft-masked genomic sequence without hard masking. Accept only A/C/G/T: boundary truncation, N, or any other residue makes the affected metric NA with a reason; NA is never pass.

motif.orientation: transcript upstream: plus [b0-50,b0); minus [b0,b0+50) reverse complement
motif.outcome: Record all motif start offsets in transcript orientation and nearest_start_offset=max(offsets); full6mer must fit in50nt. Valid window indices0..44 give offsets-50..-6 via i-50.
motif.status: PAS dependence is expected. The exact 50-nt upstream-only window is a preregistered engineering choice informed by PolyASite's -60/+10 rationale, not a derived biological optimum.

downstream_a_richness.orientation: transcript downstream: plus [b0,b0+10); minus [b0-10,b0), reverse complemented to the transcribed strand
downstream_a_richness.rules: risk=true if at least 7 consecutive A or at least 8 A in 10; otherwise false; report max A-run and A count
downstream_a_richness.status: Adapted from PolyASite's read-level IP filter to a site-level genomic check. This adaptation is a preregistered engineering choice, not the atlas method itself.

native_read_end_mispriming.role: retain as a separate native, read-based source
native_read_end_mispriming.forbidden: It does not replace the genomic downstream A-richness metric or collapse into one score.

primary.name: nearest_representative_distance
primary.definition: same mapped chromosome/strand; nearest rep0; concordant iff minimum distance <=25. Report distance histogram, tie count, and deterministic lexicographically ascending col4 representative ID; retain all tied IDs in the audit.
primary.status: 25 nt is a preregistered engineering choice echoing PolyASite merge scale; not proof of identical site
primary.tie_policy: Report full tie count and all tied unique cluster IDs; choose lexicographically smallest ID as deterministic representative. Reject duplicate clusterIDs in retained chr1 atlas.

secondary_descriptive_only.name: interval_overlap
secondary_descriptive_only.definition: same mapped chromosome/strand and intersection length >=1bp between native BED interval and atlas [start,end); do not require atlas gene annotation and native gene name to match because annotation versions differ
secondary_descriptive_only.forbidden: Never combine with nearest distance into one score; report native and atlas interval widths alongside overlap.

controls.fixture: plus canonical hexamer wholly inside exact upstream window but absent from a one-base-shifted probe
controls.expected: exact-window match is counted; shifted-probe match is not used for the frozen metric

expected.motif_reason: boundary_truncation: required upstream [−40,10) crosses contig start
expected.denominator_rule: excluded from pass/false and risk denominators; not counted as biological fail

controls.fixture: plus BED [190,200); upstream [150,200) contains one N and downstream [200,210) contains one N

expected.denominator_rule: excluded from pass/false and risk denominators; not counted as biological fail

reporting_contract.rules: For motif and A-richness use outcomes true/false/NA. NA is a separate audit class with reason, excluded from evaluable denominators and never counted as biological false/fail. Report evaluable N, pass/risk/concordant counts, false counts, NA counts and reasons by arm, strand, and stratification. Present cross-tabs but do not create a single total score or optimizer objective. Preserve failed and not-evaluable rows.
reporting_contract.coverage_delta: Compare arm-level quality summaries; define shared sites only on exact chromosome/strand/b0. Report interval-width distributions and interval counts; do not silently map shifted intervals.
reporting_contract.unit: One row per native catalogue PAS, retaining nativefailed/not-evaluable and zero-count sites. Group exact chromosome/strand/b0 endpoints without silently deduplicating rows; coverage-only endpoints are operational differences, not novel biological sites.

limitations: PolyASite is built with PAS and internal-priming filters, so motif, A-richness, and atlas agreement are correlated.
The two coverage settings are a targeted sensitivity pair, not proof of global optimality.
The native b0/p0 values are observable proxies, not proved cleavage bases.
Operational sample non-overlap does not establish donor identity independence.
No official atlas checksum is known; the observed SHA256 is a receipt fingerprint only.
This file is a method proposal; no Q1 quality result is claimed.
